niche.habitat: Dense ring bands (optical depth ~1), grazing ice and dust
niche.diet: Water ice sublimation, silicate dust, peroxide frost
niche.active: Circadian synchronized to 6.5-12.7 h orbital lap; naps during eclipses

body: Bilateral, flat discoid body with radial sail array, ventral ice-grabbers, and clathrate shell

links: Radiation pressure pushes outward at ~1 mm/s²
Organism must burn ice to counter drift and stay in ring
Reaction mass conservation in vacuum requires ejected mass

skill.effect: The creature flares its broad photonic sail and sheds a small amount of mass to push itself strongly inward or outward. You see it surge away from the center or drift toward the edges.

chains.weakness: Mass depletion; prolonged sail use starves sublimation reserves
observe: Thin plume of water vapor during thrust

journal.en: It rides the light, paying for its position in ice.

plausibility.summary: Separate the sail from the body: an ultra-thin membrane near 10 g/m², with the clathrate body too massive to sail. Let photons give anti-solar drift and let a retrograde ice jet pay for inward moves; call the clock lap-entrained, not circadian; describe the move qualitatively with no numeric effect.
fixes: Separate the sail from the body: an ultra-thin membrane near 10 g/m², with the clathrate body too massive to sail. Let photons give anti-solar drift and let a retrograde ice jet pay for inward moves; call the clock lap-entrained, not circadian; describe the move qualitatively with no numeric effect.

analogues.organism: IKAROS solar sail (2010); Poynting-Robertson drift of dust; dandelion pappus.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Mandibles grind ring ice and dust
Sublimation of water provides reaction mass
Vacuum physics demands momentum conservation for movement
Grazing and travel share one reservoir

skill.effect: The creature crushes nearby ice with its mandibles, absorbing it to restore its health and prepare its Sail Burn.

chains.weakness: Slow feed rate; unable to keep pace in high-shear lanes
observe: Mass regeneration visible in shell opacity

journal.en: The ring is food and fuel, ground to one.

plausibility.summary: No biological change; state the move qualitatively as grip-grind-vent and let the sail supply energy.
fixes: No biological change; state the move qualitatively as grip-grind-vent and let the sail supply energy.

analogues.organism: Cometary outgassing jets; Enceladus plumes; granivorous birds and rodents cracking seeds.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Nets catch silicate and organic dust
Weak planetary field leaves ring exposed to cosmic rays

skill.effect: The creature deploys its silicate-trap filtration nets, weaving a dense shield that strongly blocks harmful radiation for a short while. You see it shed a small amount of mass as the protective mesh settles around its body.

chains.weakness: Slow build time; vulnerable during net extension

journal.en: The dust builds the armor that holds the breath.

plausibility.summary: Make nets trap silicate grit embedded in a water-ammonia clathrate matrix for toughness, not silicate polymerization; get dose reduction from locally thicker ice and hiding inside ring grains, trading against sail mass (a seasonal or caste shell). Correct the citation and describe the move qualitatively.
fixes: Make nets trap silicate grit embedded in a water-ammonia clathrate matrix for toughness, not silicate polymerization; get dose reduction from locally thicker ice and hiding inside ring grains, trading against sail mass (a seasonal or caste shell). links: Peroxide serves as oxidant for electron transport
Same chemistry stocks the larder and the toxin

skill.effect: The creature's gut flora rapidly converts nearby peroxide into a powerful thrust burst, sending it surging forward. If the environment lacks sufficient ice, you may notice it falter as the chemical reaction becomes unstable.

chains.weakness: Overdose risk; peroxide >10 mM damages gut flora

plausibility.summary: No chain fix; describe the surge qualitatively as buffered detoxification that vents heated water/oxygen, keep the overdose consequence from F22, and use frost crystals or chemiluminescence instead of a glowing reservoir.

body_plan.origin: Descended from impact-ejected grazer lineages; shell forms from ring silicates

temperament: Docile drift, skittish shear, communal phasing
secrets: Sails can be folded to hide thermal signature from predators.
Spore shells can survive Kessler cascades if buried in silicate.
Orbital phasing can sync gamete meeting across lanes.
moments: A swarm of Polvovela aligns their sails to create a momentary, perfect reflection of the star, signaling a mass spawning event before scattering into the dark like a shattered mirror.

journal.en: The ring is not silent; it sings in ice-thrust and light.
To graze is to burn oneself to stay in place.
